employee_identity_subject_uq.name: employee_identity_subject_uq
employee_identity_subject_uq.where: google_subject is not null and current = true

exception_dedupe_open_uq.name: exception_dedupe_open_uq
exception_dedupe_open_uq.where: dedupe_key is not null and state <> 'resolved'

job_dedupe_active_uq.name: job_dedupe_active_uq
job_dedupe_active_uq.where: dedupe_key is not null and status in ('queued','running','waiting')

notice_pending_dedupe_uq.name: notice_pending_dedupe_uq
notice_pending_dedupe_uq.where: dedupe_key is not null and state in ('intended','manual_pending')

stock_position_qty_chk.name: stock_position_qty_chk
stock_position_qty_chk.value: on_hand_qty >= 0 and unavailable_qty >= 0 and pending_inspection_qty >= 0 and in_transit_qty >= 0

order_line_qty_chk.name: order_line_qty_chk
order_line_qty_chk.value: ordered_qty > 0 and current_qty >= 0 and cancelled_qty >= 0 and delivered_qty >= 0 and delivered_qty <= current_qty
